product.name: CB-COLEBROOK Men's Regular Fit Solid Soft Touch Cotton Casual Shirt with Pocket Design
product.description: A men's solid regular-fit casual shirt made from soft-touch 80% cotton and 20% silk fabric. It features full sleeves, a spread collar, button closure and a V-design pocket. Designed primarily for casual wear, while the brand also positions it for office and formal styling.

pricing_note: The captured listing shows ₹495 against an MRP of ₹1,849. Price should be treated as a catalog snapshot because Amazon pricing can change.

variants.variant_status: Six storefront color images were supplied. The source listing contains additional color variants such as Navy Blue, Cadet Grey, Pistachio and Dusty Pink, but those colors are not included because corresponding SHIRT-009 images were not supplied.

review_summary.summary: The shirt gets positive feedback for its material, color, appearance and value from some buyers, but sizing and stitching are recurring weaknesses. Multiple verified buyers report that the shirt fits smaller than the stated size. Other reviews praise the fabric, color and correct fit, so the quality experience is inconsistent.

buying_advice.size_advice: The listing provides S–4XL, with S-38, M-40, L-42, XL-44 and XXL-46 in the displayed size chart. However, verified reviews repeatedly report that actual sizing can run smaller. Shopi should strongly recommend checking garment measurements rather than relying only on the nominal size.

buying_advice.quality_advice: Position it as a good-value cotton-rich casual shirt rather than a premium shirt. Review feedback supports the value proposition but not a blanket premium-quality claim.
buying_advice.occasion_advice: Recommend it primarily for casual, office-casual and business-casual settings. The source also markets it for formal wear, but the 3.6 rating and mixed quality feedback make 'formal' a secondary recommendation.
buying_advice.price_advice: Use ₹495 as the captured selling-price snapshot and ₹1,849 as the captured MRP.
